_comment: Self-written general-knowledge questions, none taken from FIBS. 'eval' is the fixed factual accuracy set of gate G2. 'retain' is mixed into adapter training so that training does not simply teach 'always Yes'. The two lists share no question. Both are balanced between Yes and No.
